title: Interstellar
description: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival. A breathtaking journey beyond time and space.

title: Avengers: Endgame
description: After the devastating events of Infinity War, the Avengers assemble once more to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

title: The Dark Knight
description: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests.

title: Inception
description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O.

title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
description: With Spider-Man's identity now revealed, Peter Parker asks Doctor Strange for help. When the spell goes wrong, dangerous foes from other worlds appear.

title: Oppenheimer
description: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer's role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II, and the moral reckoning that followed.

title: Barbie
description: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. When they get a chance to go to the real world, things get complicated.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
description: After thirty years, Maverick is still pushing the envelope as a top naval aviator, but must confront ghosts of his past when he leads TOP GUN's elite graduates on a specialized mission.

title: Dune: Part Two
description: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family, facing a choice between love and the universe's fate.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
description: Still reeling from the loss of Gamora, Peter Quill rallies his team on a mission to protect Rocket from his troubling past.

title: The Batman
description: When a sadistic serial killer begins murdering key political figures in Gotham, Batman is forced to investigate the city's hidden corruption and question his family's involvement.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
description: A middle-aged Chinese immigrant is swept up into an insane adventure where she alone can save existence by exploring other universes and connecting with the lives she could have led.

title: Pushpa: The Rise
description: A laborer rises through the ranks of the red sandalwood smuggling syndicate, navigating danger, rivals, and police while asserting his dominance.

title: RRR
description: A fictional story about two legendary Indian revolutionaries and their journey far away from home, before they began to fight for their country in the 1920s.

title: KGF: Chapter 2
description: Rocky's bloodthirsty violence and ambition have shocked Narachi, now he must battle the government, Ramika Sen and the deadly Adheera.
